name: S.S. Ellison Onizuka
about: S.S. Ellison Onizuka (2021-072A), a crewed vehicle (Cygnus), launched 2021 Aug 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2021 Aug 10), held fixed
docked to A06499; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
